name: Pakistan Air Force JF-17 Thunder Squadron
detail: Deployed to Prince Sultan Air Base under the Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement during the 2026 Iran war; the bulk of roughly 16 Pakistani combat aircraft sent to help defend Saudi airspace.

name: HQ-9 Air Defense Battery
detail: Long-range surface-to-air missile system deployed by Pakistan to Saudi Arabia as part of its SMDA troop contribution during Iranian missile and drone strikes on Saudi territory.

name: Pakistani Drone Squadrons
detail: Reconnaissance and strike drone units deployed alongside Pakistani ground troops to reinforce Saudi air defense during the 2026 Iran war.

name: Pakistani Army Contingent
detail: Reported at roughly 8,000 troops during the active war (May 2026) rising to a reported 13,000 post-ceasefire, deployed to help secure Saudi military installations under the mutual defense agreement. Figures are contested across sources.

name: Turkish Defense-Technology Contribution
detail: Under the Mecca pact's functional division of labor, Turkey is designated to provide advanced defense technology and manufacturing capacity to the alliance, building on its domestic drone and missile industry.

name: Saudi Financing Commitment
detail: Saudi Arabia's designated role in the pact's division of labor is financing and funding joint defense projects, drawing on its $63.9B annual defense budget — the largest of the three signatories.

name: Joint Secretariat (Planned, Riyadh)
detail: A permanent secretariat plus ministerial, political and military committees is planned to be based in Saudi Arabia per FM Hakan Fidan's August 2026 remarks — not yet operational as of Aug 20, 2026.
